sourceLines.text: DM: “All I can tell you is this: I have observed the nature of life here, such as it is. sourceLines.raw: [u0482 | notes] DM: “All I can tell you is this: I have observed the nature of life here, such as it is. There are things that live in Limbo, but they are so unstable and changeable that, even as they grow larger and more powerful, they turn into great weather fronts that travel across the land but have no will or purpose behind them.

sourceLines.text: DM: “Or rather, their will and purpose change from moment to moment such that they can never accomplish anything. Eventually they grow so big that they fragment into tiny motes of possibility that grow.
sourceLines.raw: [u0483 | notes] DM: “Or rather, their will and purpose change from moment to moment such that they can never accomplish anything. Eventually they grow so big that they fragment into tiny motes of possibility that grow.

sourceLines.raw: [u0484 | notes] DM: “Sometimes you see what look like beasts moving through the landscape, several of these filaments grown together. Eventually they merge and grow into bigger and bigger loci of chaos.
